title: T-030 embedding provenance audit
summary: All 26,559 staging embeddings passed dimension, finite-value, and normalization checks. No re-embedding is required.
evidence: All 26,559 vectors are 1,536-dimensional, finite, and unit-normalized within tolerance.
One exact content-level duplicate was found and classified low severity.
The embedding model is code-inferred as OpenAI text-embedding-3-small because the database does not store model provenance.
The missing embedding_model column is recorded as medium-severity schema debt.
Only the sanitized report was added, the worktree has no remote, and the read-only database checksum remained unchanged.
The successful Claude run was subscription-included with no metered Anthropic API billing.
limitations: Model provenance remains inferred until a future schema change records it explicitly.
